items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Shelly said, told me, he said he can bust this record.

ctx.x: Yeah, well give me two, I can't.

But okay. Now he was in one, he said, look, he could break a record. He was the best New Orleans has ever had for breaking records. He could take a record and break it. Cause he had this knack for playing a record, and then he played, and then he played. And you see, he don't go on no radio station where he don't have complete control of his program. Program director didn't tell him what to do. Okay. That's why he always moved. And when he got to listen to what the program director did, he gone. Because he can…
